newsitem.title: DENMARK: Sell Danish long bonds against Swedish - BG bank.
newsitem.headline: Sell Danish long bonds against Swedish - BG bank.

text.p: Denmark's BG bank on Friday recommended the sale of Danish 10-year government bonds against equivalent Swedish paper, predicting that the spread between them would shrink by 20 basis points over the coming quarter.
Rising yields on the Stockholm market after Prime Minister Goran Persson's pledge to boost welfare funding were exaggerated and likely to be short-lived the bank wrote in an analysis.

"BG bank believes that the market has over-reacted and expects continued repo rate cuts together with a tough fiscal policy, leading to a narrowing of the yield gap," the bank, Denmark's third-largest, said.

"On that basis the spread is expected to narrow and to return over the next three months to around 10 basis points," it added, basing its forecast on the gap between the Danish eight percent 10-year bond and the Swedish 6.50 percent bond, currently 30 bp.
